title: Killed-current control for a source-conditioned switch from any actual ordered-core input
statement: For a finite reversible ordered core,actual incoming probability rho,H>0,nu=rho(-Q+diag H)^-1,f=nu/mu,the killed edge current I_j=sum_{l<=j}(rho_l-nu_l H_l) has |I_j|<=1. For monotone0<=u<=1 and0<=cprime_j<=epsilon*c_j,the absolute post-conductance Dirichlet pairing is<=epsilon,without monotone f or a stationary input.

requires: Actual finite ordered birth/death core,positive acquired reversible reference,actual probability rho and positive total killing hazard. No entrance reset or Green-density monotonicity assumed.

Monotone winning u and acquired post/pre conductance comparison. For the C3 consequence at anchors1,1,own C_i>=n throughout the WHOLE component and exact muprime=mu/(C_i+1)/source-weight cancellation are necessary.
provides: C3 selected-port joint bound P(first source1_i,then competing k_i at the next block event before own source2_i)<=3 alpha_i1/(2 alpha_i2 n),including first-source selection,for any actual incoming law. Other peer residual sign may be arbitrary.
With both negative gaps>=n,sum gives the prior two-phase source1 bound for any incoming law;old empty-endpoint v1 remains valid.
assumptions: Reference weights and relative normalization must obey the raw source retag,not be chosen to force a comparison.
costs: Actual killed Green/current and complete source weight retained. Probability control alone does not pay a physical return;corner laws separately pay clock/count/output.
contract.units: Joint-event probability and acquired finite ordered-core current.
contract.obstruction: No uniform conditional bound after a rare selected source. On higher-dimensional graphs,per-edge current control does not bound total variation;that raw operation must be earned. No global recurrence or practical runtime advantage.

evidence.quote: # The source-conditioned switch works from ANY actual input law
evidence.range_scope: Read full zero-gate/gap/minority predicates or whole-component ordered-current requirements.

body: Version2 removes the boundary-only Green-monotonicity restriction using killed-current control. Version1 and its governing source are immutable and valid. Source retagging,whole-component coordinate floor and first-source weighting remain essential;this is not an arbitrary-graph theorem. Physical stages observe their next actual block event;additional exits may be omitted only in the proof upper comparison,not from the physical operation.

review.scope: Root read both governing notes,same author,not a new independent audit. Original programs/results are data,not imported or rerun. No P3 held proof.
